easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Izoni, adding {C}{C}.
When Izoni dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Izoni from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Izoni enters, it triggers, creating at least one creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.
